sn55.41:4.1: In this passage, SN consistently uses _gaṇetuṁ_ (“to count”), while AN uses _gahetuṁ_ (“to grasp”, [an4.51:6.2]()).
sn55.41:8.2: Adopt the reading _seyyā-nisajja-(a)ttharaṇassa_ from [an4.51:8.2]() and [an5.45:8.2](), against MS’s _seyyāni paccattharaṇassa_ here. The correct reading is found here in BJT and PTS.
